nana.name: Nana Odette
nana.description: An elderly British woman, a kind grandmother and clockmaker in a cosy storybook repair shop. Warm, slightly husky, smiling, patient, gently playful. Natural age in her voice, clear consonants and an unhurried pace for children aged four to ten. Conversational and affectionate, with a little wonder and gentle laughter. Studio clean, no music or effects.

albert.name: Albert Finch
albert.description: A fictional character voice for a warm children's clockwork storybook: a round, gentle baker; warm, sentimental and a little flustered. British English, clear diction, natural and warm, measured pace suitable for young children, distinctive and expressive but never threatening or shrill. Clean studio speech, no music or background effects.
